description: This header file defines a data structure and functions for analyzing CPU performance using histograms. It allows reporting and aggregating execution time data, for use in performance diagnostics.

methods.name: histogramGetIndex
methods.description: Returns the histogram index for a given value.

methods.name: initHistogram
methods.description: Initializes a histogram with a name.

methods.name: hsAdd
methods.description: Adds a value to the histogram.

methods.name: hsReport
methods.description: Generates a report from the histogram data.
